neighbours.label: the comma or period closing a short maxim or generic claim (Seeing is believing, ...; Love conquers all, ...)
fire: Knowledge is power, however not everyone agrees.

"Practice makes perfect". Be ready to work hard.

Beauty fades, however, and then what remains?
Patience pays off. These days I wait calmly.
Experience matters, and hers is unmatched.
